name: Cebreros
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: Cebreros's wines are made from Albillo Real for white and mainly Garnacha Tinta for red, with Tempranillo and Garnacha Tintorera also allowed.
